# Entity Existence

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:EntityExistence`](gmeow-EntityExistence.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/EntityExistence>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lifecycle`](../../slices/lifecycle.md)

The reified, time-scoped fact that an entity existed over an interval — a [gufo:Situation](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Situation) that carries its period via [`gmeow:duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md) (inherited from [`TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)). Use when the existence claim is contested (two sources disagree on when a place ceased to exist), when evidence must be attached, or when standpoint indexing is needed. Flat-first: the common case uses [`gmeow:hasCreationEvent`](../properties/gmeow-hasCreationEvent.md) / [`gmeow:hasDestructionEvent`](../properties/gmeow-hasDestructionEvent.md) / [`gmeow:existenceInterval`](../properties/gmeow-existenceInterval.md) directly on the entity.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:EntityExistence`](gmeow-EntityExistence.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
